subject.title: fix(cron): bound cron quarantine sidecar file reads

question: Should this PR intentionally make previously accepted oversized, symlinked, or non-regular cron quarantine sidecars fail closed, with operator repair as the upgrade recovery contract?
rationale: The implementation and proof are complete, but green CI cannot decide whether blocking cron persistence on incompatible shipped state is the intended upgrade policy.

options.title: Accept strict recovery contract
options.body: Approve the 8 MiB regular-file boundary and ensure operators receive an actionable doctor or error path for repairing the sidecar.

options.title: Add automated repair first
options.body: Add a bounded doctor migration or reset path before enforcing the stricter runtime contract.

recommendation.title: Accept strict recovery contract
recommendation.body: Approve the 8 MiB regular-file boundary and ensure operators receive an actionable doctor or error path for repairing the sidecar.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored and merged the current SQLite cron persistence and doctor boundary, making him the strongest available owner for this upgrade decision.
